props.name: label
props.description: Names the group — "Pickup time". Required: an unnamed radio group is announced as just "group".

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when no slot is available. Default "No times are available."

props.name: timeZoneLabel
props.description: The time zone the labels are in. Shown, and used as the group's description.

props.name: unavailableLabel
props.description: Spoken after an unavailable slot's label. Default "Unavailable".
